utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s going along steadily. I’d say we should keep to the plan and check back again later today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check back later today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help spread the word and bring any tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word and see what tools I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, the repair drive? Just to confirm—it's still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the timing and drop-off details first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, thanks for checking—can you confirm the time and where we should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my toolbox. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few things checked: the loose gate, the porch light, and maybe extra screws for the bench.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can handle the gate and grab some screws. I’ll swing back with my toolbox in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what details do we need to confirm first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — we should probably confirm what needs fixing, when to start, and who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — let’s pin down the exact repairs, pick a start time, and make a tools list. Do you want me to check who can bring what?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — it’s going pretty well so far, just trying to keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — do you need another pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with the repair drive—what tools or supplies do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus — I could use a screwdriver set, some duct tape, and a wrench if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive details handy — where should I drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you bring everything by the school office after pickup? I’ll make sure it gets sorted from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll drop everything at the school office after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community hall. If you’re heading over, I can walk you through what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds great — I’m heading over soon and I’d love the walkthrough. If you hear of anyone else who wants to pitch in, I can spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful — word-of-mouth will help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anyone else wants to chip in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive, or do you need help with anything first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still on for it — just need a quick hand carrying the boxes, if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, I’m free — where do you want me to meet you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll help spread the word and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping me in the loop. I’ll pass that along and watch for the next update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep nudging folks and let you know as soon as I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive notes together now. If you’ve got any supplies or volunteer updates, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I don’t have any updates yet, but I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — appreciate it. I’ll keep the notes moving and check back if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting set up soon—folks are already talking about what needs fixing first. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Please let me know once they’ve got the list and the schedule nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the list and schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ve been telling folks the repair drive is still on, and I’m just waiting to confirm the drop-off time. I’ll repeat the details once I get the final word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — thanks, Vik. Just let me know the drop-off time and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I think we still need someone to sort the donated parts and help keep track of who’s signed up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donated parts and keep the sign-up list updated. Just show me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—can you start with the loose fence panel by the east gate? I’ve also got a list of the busted porch light and the cracked sidewalk by Maple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can handle the fence panel first and then check the porch light and sidewalk.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great — I can help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — right now we need people to bring in small broken items and sign up to help at the table. Could you also ask folks to label anything tricky so we can sort it faster?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for small broken items, volunteers for the table, and to label anything tricky. I can help make sure it all gets sorted quickly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, so what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s still on for this Saturday at the community hall — we’re gathering tools and spare parts first, then anyone can drop off broken items. If you want, I can send you the time and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send me the time and the list of what you still need — I’ll try to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized pretty well—what do you need me to bring by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your drill and a couple extra screwdrivers? That’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll bring my drill and a couple extra screwdrivers by later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and stack the boxes by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and stack the boxes by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—what time are we meeting, and do we know who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s meet at 9 by the community shed, and I’ll bring the tool kit. Can you handle the snacks and labels?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can handle the snacks and labels. I just want to make sure we have enough and that everything’s easy to carry.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m glad you asked — we’re kicking off the repair drive soon, and you should definitely come by. I’ll make sure you get an invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’d love that. Let me know what supplies you still need and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the supply list over, and if you spot anything, that’d be a huge help. I’m excited to have you involved!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive details. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’ll get them to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — send them when you can, and I’ll fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure neighbors know what’s needed. Let’s figure out the first few homes to visit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve heard the list is pretty short so far. If you want, I can help spread the word to the next few houses.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Nell — I’ll jot down the first houses, and you can help reach the next few. Together we’ll get the word out quickly.
